about: T-4144: the public Banská Bystrica + BBSK assistant's fixed questions. Every `must` fact is quoted from the page in `sources` as it read on 2026-10-15 (worker-4); a `must` entry is a list of alternatives, one of which the answer has to contain (compared without spaces, slashes or dashes, a time's dot read as a colon). `data` questions are answered from the platform's own datasets on data.{domain}; `unknown` ones are covered by no source, so the answer says it does not know and links an official contact.
